methodologyNotes: Covers standalone corded electric curling tools sold at a published US price: spring-clamp curling irons, motorized rotating-clamp irons, enclosed auto-curlers, and clampless curling wands. Excludes multi-attachment air stylers (e.g. airflow rotating/wrap multi-tools), hot-air curling brushes, flat/straightening irons, and crimpers/wavers. Price is typical US retail or MSRP in USD. barrelType is an enum: 'clip-iron' (spring-clamp), 'rotating-iron' (motorized rotating clamp), 'auto-curler' (enclosed curl chamber), or 'wand' (clampless). barrelShape is an enum: 'straight' (uniform diameter) or 'tapered' (diameter narrows toward the tip). barrelDiameterIn is barrel diameter in inches; for tapered barrels give a base-to-tip range (e.g. '1.1-0.75'). barrelLengthIn is the heated styling length of the barrel in inches. barrelCoating is the barrel surface material/finish as an enum (e.g. 'ceramic', 'tourmaline-ceramic', 'titanium', 'gold-plated', 'ceramic-mineral'). maxTempF is the maximum barrel temperature in degrees Fahrenheit. heatSettings is the count of user-selectable heat settings as an integer (1 for a single fixed temperature). heatUpTimeSec is the manufacturer-stated heat-up-to-ready time in seconds; null if not disclosed. autoShutoffMin is the automatic shut-off timer in minutes; null if none. dualVoltage is a boolean, true if rated for worldwide 100-240V. cordLengthFt is the power cord length in feet. weightGrams is the tool weight in grams without cord; null if not disclosed.
